I also did not find a clear, comprehensive crackdown on vigilantes or loyalist enforcers; the record is mostly partial and reactive.","evidence":[{"title":"2024 Country Reports on Human Rights Practices: Philippines","publisher":"U.S. Department of State","date":"2024","url":"https://www.ecoi.net/en/document/2128580.html","summary":"The report says the Marcos administration shifted the antidrug campaign toward treatment, due process, and rule-of-law investigations. This is a real intervention against tolerated abuse, though it is not mainly a police or military accountability move.","question_ids":["3B.2"]},{"title":"Marcos announces ban on all POGO","publisher":"GMA News Online","date":"2024-07-22","url":"https://www.gmanetwork.com/news/topstories/nation/914272/marcos-announces-ban-on-all-pogo/story/","summary":"The president framed the ban as stopping “grave abuse” and illegal acts and ordered the industry wound down.
